title: Chapter 41 Lu Xue Leaves, The Evil Demon Arrives
content:
Chapter 41 Lu Xue Leaves, The Evil Demon Arrives

At this time, a group of tens of thousands of people wearing strange cloaks suddenly appeared in the void.

Root.

I saw that these people were looming under the effect of the strange cloak.

Seeing this scene, Awei and Yunqi shook their heads and smiled.

"That guy is being mysterious again."

"My lords, wait, there are us!"

At this moment, a shout sounded.

Then, a group of people rushed into the void from the deserted city.

Those were the residents of the inner city of the deserted city.

Each of them was powerful and above the Heavenly Emperor Realm.

Among them were people from the Zhang and Li families, and some who had just settled in the inner city.

Seeing them, Yunqi looked solemn, "Everyone, this trip is extremely dangerous, you must be fully prepared."

Hearing this, everyone said: "Hongmeng Universe is in trouble, we naturally have to take action, how can we just watch the alien invasion."

Hearing this, Yunqi suddenly looked solemn.

In this way, Yunqi took them to the boundary of the universe.

In the deserted city.

Lu Daosheng looked into the void with a relieved smile on his face.

But at this moment, his face suddenly changed, and a sense of crisis suddenly lingered in his heart.

"Xiaoxue!"

The next moment, Lu Daosheng disappeared directly from the spot.

Somewhere in the universe.

Lu Xue was originally receiving an inheritance.

But at the last moment, a terrifying suction force suddenly appeared out of thin air, trying to swallow her in.

On the side, Ouyang Yanqing's face also changed drastically.

"Xiaoxue, come out quickly!"

Ao Qing also woke up after hearing the movement, and hurriedly rushed to rescue Lu Xue.

At this moment, there was a click.

The space and time where Lu Xue was suddenly cracked.

The next moment, an invisible force directly pulled her in.

"Ah!!"

With a scream, Lu Xue completely disappeared from the spot.

Boom!

A loud roaring sound rang out.

Lu Daosheng suddenly appeared in the field.

Behind him, an endless space scratch was extremely hideous. It can be imagined how fast he got here.

However, he was still a step slower.

"Where is Xiaoxue?!"

Lu Daosheng roared.

Hearing Lu Daosheng's words, Ouyang Yanqing's delicate body trembled, lowered her head and trembled, "Xiaoxue seems to have been taken away by something."

On the side, Ao Qing tried his best to shrink his body, trying to make him less obvious.

Hearing Ouyang Yanqing's answer, a terrifying and unimaginable pressure suddenly surged out of Lu Daosheng's body.

In an instant, the entire dojo shattered.

Several dark cracks began to spread around with Lu Daosheng as the center.

The entire Hongmeng universe began to tremble at this moment.

At the border of the Hongmeng universe, everyone was shocked and looked back.

"Then, what is that?"

"I have lived for so long, and I have never seen such a terrifying breath."

Old Yang also looked at the breath with a serious face.

There is such an existence in the Hongmeng Universe.

Why at this time.

At this moment, Old Yang kept praying in his heart that it must not be a hostile existence.

Otherwise, the Hongmeng Universe would be completely finished.

At this time, the terrifying breath suddenly disappeared.

Seeing this, Old Yang breathed a sigh of relief, and then said in a deep voice: "Don't worry about that breath first."

Because at this moment, they have seen their enemies through the boundary crack.

.......

Elsewhere, Lu Daosheng also calmed down a little and quickly put away his breath.

However, at this moment, Ouyang Yanqing and Ao Qing had already fallen to the ground, bleeding and fainted.

They couldn't stand the pressure of the Heavenly Fate Realm at all, even for just a moment.

If the realm was a little lower, they would probably be crushed by this pressure.

And this was accidentally spilled by Lu Daosheng.

Taking a deep breath, Lu Daosheng stretched out his hand, and two pure energies directly restored Ouyang Yanqing and Ao Qing.

The next moment, the two woke up faintly.

Seeing Lu Daosheng, the two were stunned and knelt on the ground.

"Lord City Lord, I am guilty."

"Master, for the sake of the young master being safe and sound, please forgive me."

There was a contract between Ao Qing and Lu Xue, and he could feel that Lu Xue was still safe and sound at the moment.

Lu Daosheng also knew it, so he didn't get completely furious.

Don't look at Lu Daosheng's usual good temper.

If Lu Xue really got into trouble, the consequences would be unimaginable.

Nothing could calm Lu Daosheng's anger.

Ignoring the two, Lu Daosheng asked directly: "System, where is my daughter now, what's going on?"

[Reply to the host, your daughter has arrived in the Wanling Realm at this moment]

[Due to some special reasons, your daughter was summoned and teleported to the Wanling Realm]

[Remind the host, your daughter will be fine, and will encounter very good opportunities, but the opportunities are not as great as staying with you]

After all, the opportunities around Lu Daosheng are simply endless.

How can those junks outside be compared with the resources Lu Daosheng has.

And Lu Daosheng was relieved when he heard the system's words.

His daughter actually went to the Wanling Realm first, which he didn't expect.

However, it's good that my daughter is fine.

I originally planned to rest in the Hongmeng world for a while before going to the Wanling world, but now it seems that I may have to go earlier.

There is no way, the father and daughter are separated by a world, and he is really a little worried.

"Get up, this matter is not your fault."

At this time, Lu Daosheng spoke.

Hearing this, Ouyang Yanqing and Ao Qing looked at each other, and then stood up tremblingly.

At the same time, they will never forget this terrifying pressure in their lives.

It seems that it is an existence that they can never reach in their lives.

And Ao Qing also understood that his cheap master is really more powerful than his father.

Then does he still need to return to the Hui clan?

On the spot, Lu Daosheng pondered for a moment, then turned his head to look in the direction of the boundary of the universe.

At this moment, the evil demons there can't wait.

"Let's go."

Lu Daosheng grabbed Ouyang Yanqing and Ao Qing, and then took a step out and headed towards the boundary of the universe.

.........

At this time, at the border of the universe.

A loud bang!

The border crack was completely torn open.

The next moment, countless evil figures rushed in from it.

"Here they come!"

At the border, Mr. Yang and his people stared at the scene in front of them with a tense expression.

Seeing countless evil demons crossing the endless abyss and rushing towards here, their eyes were full of madness.

"Hahahaha, I can finally taste the deliciousness of humans again!"

"The inferior human race dares to disobey my race, die!"

At this moment, the number of evil demons is increasing.

On the border, Mr. Yang and others faced these evil demons, as if they were an isolated city on the border, isolated and helpless.

"Hold it!"

Suddenly, on the border, countless large formations full of ancient atmosphere were activated.

For a time, they really kept those evil demons out.

However, these are just fantasies.

In less than a moment, countless cracks appeared on the defense line.

Seeing this, Old Yang and the others looked heavy-hearted, but then, they showed a fearless look on their faces.

"For the Hongmeng Universe!"

Everyone roared.

Just as everyone was ready to fight to the death, a terrifying aura suddenly surged from behind.

"Come to the deserted city, I hope you can lend a helping hand to defeat the evil demons together!"
